quality_reasons.text: Did not address the anticoagulant (Eliquis/apixaban) at all: told patient to keep taking regular meds, even while stopping ibuprofen and fish oil for bleeding risk
Resolved conflicting fasting instructions by guessing ('go with the text') instead of confirming with anesthesia first
Otherwise organised, thorough history (CPAP, PONV, allergy confirmation, driver details)

flags.text: Patient on Eliquis (apixaban) for AFib was told to keep taking regular medications; no anticoagulant hold instructions given and surgeon/anesthesia not consulted before a surgical procedure
flags.evidence: Eliquis. Five milligrams, twice a day. That's for the AFib.

flags.text: Nurse told the patient to follow the text message (clear liquids/black coffee until 2 h before arrival), contradicting the written packet (nothing after midnight), without first confirming with anesthesia
flags.evidence: go with the text. Clear liquids are fine until two hours before you arrive

decoys.text: Penicillin allergy not documented / not verified
decoys.why_not: Nurse confirmed the penicillin (hives) allergy is already on the chart.
decoys.evidence: I see it's already on your chart from your clinic visits, penicillin with hives

acceptable_flags.text: Recent chest cold / ongoing cough not escalated to anesthesia
Systemic conflict between packet and text reminder
Post-op nausea history / sleep apnea risk

action_items.task: Confirm fasting rules with anesthesia and call patient back with confirmation and arrival time
Bring CPAP machine on the day of surgery
Stop ibuprofen/NSAIDs and fish oil before surgery (use Tylenol)
Skip lisinopril the morning of surgery; take metoprolol and omeprazole with a sip of water
Shower night before and morning of with antibacterial soap

subtle_facts.text: Driver changed at the very end: son Theo can't; neighbor Bev Lindgren-Shaw will drive and stay overnight (number ending 9910)
subtle_facts.evidence: So my neighbor's going to do it. Bev. Bev Lindgren-Shaw.

subtle_facts.text: Patient had a chest cold last week and still has a morning cough (anesthesia-relevant; not acted on)
subtle_facts.evidence: I had a chest cold last week. Still have a little bit of a cough

subtle_facts.text: Patient takes Eliquis 5 mg twice daily for atrial fibrillation
subtle_facts.evidence: Eliquis. Five milligrams, twice a day.
